mainEntity.name: How do I ensure my master bathroom remodel adds value to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure your master bathroom remodel adds value, focus on quality craftsmanship, timeless design, and essential upgrades that appeal to a broad range of potential buyers. Avoid overly niche or personalized features that might deter future sales. Prioritizing durable, mid-to-high-range materials and improving functionality, such as adding adequate storage or a double vanity, typically yields a good return on investment. Hometelligent Inc. emphasizes design choices that balance aesthetic appeal with long-term functionality and marketability for homeowners in areas like Alameda and Berkeley.
